checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 5 seconds long, follows first 5s of the source
must.why: The frames show the same scene and motion as the source, and the clip is 5 s.
The face still looks like the original woman, with light skin, the same brown hair and the same features. It does not resemble the dark-eyed portrait woman.

must.item: Kitchen, body motion and framing remain
must.why: The kitchen, pose and framing are unchanged.
The clip has audio at a -0.9 dB peak, but the spoken words can't be judged from the frames. The mouth movements look natural.

must.item: Face remains aligned without flicker or doubled features
must.why: The sampled frames show no doubled features or misalignment.

faults.what: The portrait identity was not transferred. The face is a subtly altered version of the original woman, so the swap largely failed.
The face is softer and slightly changed in the frame at 0.5 s, with a hand-over-face area that looks lightly retouched.

summary: The clip is clean and keeps the scene and motion, but the face doesn't look like the portrait woman, so the requested face swap didn't succeed.
